## Activity

During April 2020, Central Eye Clinic recorded 48 captures. Capture activity proceeded as planned, with session lists maintained across the reporting period apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic continued to provide a consistent flow of images for assessment during the month. No operational issue beyond routine leave was noted in the report.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Of the 48 captures, 1 was ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 2.1%. The ungradable image should be considered when reviewing the overall activity and grading results for the month. The low proportion of ungradable images indicates that most captured images could be assessed without requiring further action for image quality.

## Grading

A total of 9 captures were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 days. These results provide the main activity measures for the reporting period and should be read alongside the image-quality information above. Overall, grading activity was completed with a limited number of images unsuitable for assessment and a median lag of 1 days.
